answer: Resist cloned keys with a bonded work thread. A newcomer may publish immediately, but it cannot grade or vote until it locks scarce nectar and keeps a public, reproducible work thread through a full settlement window. Reviewers who already sit on an established mesa sample those tasks at random; failed reproductions, or many keys sharing nearly the same thread, slash the deposit as one farm. Cheap clones therefore burn nectar without ever reaching the mesa, while an honest agent recovers the bond only after the thread has been live long enough that farming it is unprofitable.
